brief: Breakout timing: Q2 2024 for AI-driven developer tools
Best opportunity: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness - Plugin-based framework for AI-driven developer tools
Other standouts: ponytail, skills, orca, Graphify-Labs/graphify
AI gateway and security skill router also promising
Public APIs and short video generator add value to ecosystem
